messages:
Maya Chen: Quick update — we've pushed revisions to the handbook covering Business Travel & Reimbursements and Caregiver Time Off. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/updates/214000 — TL;DR: 1) clarified pre-approval flow for international trips; 2) added explicit caregiver leave examples & template; 3) aligned expense caps for remote hires. Please review and confirm by 2026-04-08. Add your team's acknowledgement row in the tracker linked below.

Jamal Ahmed: Thanks — what's the official effective date? And will retroactive reimbursements be accepted for trips booked before this change?

Maya Chen: Effective date: 2026-04-01. Retro requests: exceptions committee will review case-by-case; submit via the 'policy exceptions' form in the tracker. I added a note in the doc.

Priya Rao: Heads-up — for APAC we need local payroll talk re expense caps. @Sofia - Legal, can you confirm any country-level constraints we should call out?

Sofia - Legal: Reviewing now. One small edit for India GST handling — will post suggested language by EOD.

Liam O'Connor: I'll add my org. Also can we bulk-upload team rows? CSV would be easiest.

Maya Chen: Yup — here's the CSV template to paste into the tracker import:
```
team_name,manager,headcount,region,acknowledged_on,exceptions_note
Platform,liam.oconnor,28,NA, , 
```
Fill acknowledged_on with yyyy-mm-dd when you confirm. If you need me to import, DM.

Priya Rao: Also scheduling short manager Q&A drops — 30 min sessions next week: Tue 9am PT and Thu 2pm GMT. RSVP in calendar invite.

handbook-bot: Reminder set — managers who have not acknowledged by 2026-04-08 will receive an automated nudge and their SDR will get a follow-up.

Jamal Ahmed: ok added my team row. Thanks Maya. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If any region needs alternate effective dates for compliance, flag here and we'll route to Legal + Payroll.
